title: The Night Sky Zimbabwe — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage stars night sky
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The night sky in Zimbabwe has no competition from the city
And the Milky Way is something more than just a word for pretty
The Southern Cross sits overhead as it always has
And the night sky doesn't care about the borders and the jazz

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Denga remangwanani reZimbabwe harina nharo nerezveguta
[The Zimbabwe night sky has no argument with city glow]
Nzira yeMudenga inoita zvakanyanya kupfura mashoko
[The Milky Way does more than words can say]
Nyenyedzi dzeChifambamwana dziri pedyo namaziso edu
[The Southern Cross stars are close to our eyes]
Denga harizivi muganhu wenharaunda — rinoziva zvose
[The sky knows no boundary of the neighbourhood — it knows all]

[Chorus — English]
The night sky Zimbabwe knows no boundary of the nation
The night sky Zimbabwe is the oldest form of education
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
Isibhakabhaka sezulu eZimbabwe asinankampethu
[The night sky of Zimbabwe has no competition]
INkanyezi yoMzansi imi phezulu njalo
[The Southern Cross stands overhead always]
Inzalo yami yakulala phandle ezinkanyezini
[My family slept outside under the stars]
Nezwakazi lomhlaba uyazi wonke umuntu
[The universe knows every person]

[Outro — All three languages]
Night sky Zimbabwe… Denga reZimbabwe… Isibhakabhaka seZimbabwe
The stars watched all of it — Nyenyedzi dzakacherekedza zvose — Izinkanyezi zikhangele konke
The gardens still growing
